x: On December 13th we visited the splendid quarters of the Metropolitan Police at Imber Court for our walking match. Our party numbered twelve but could not be described as our strongest team for some of our walkers were engaged in preparing for the "Godstone" Walk.

We numbered twelve walkers, the Police fielding about three times our numbers, and it was agreed to score ten aside. From the start Harry Churcher went into the lead, and but for going off the course towards the end of the race, would have undoubtedly lowered the course record.

Rickett's Shield" and sealed handicap, a match had been arranged with the Metropolitan Police, and accordingly a large field started out. The invitation of our course, to retire from the race at 8, 11 or 17 miles, was accepted by many, however, and less than half the starters completed the course.
